question: Which river flows into the Wular lake in the north and then into Baramulla?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jhelum**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Jhelum** is the river that flows into the Wular Lake in the north and then into Baramulla.
 
• Wular Lake, one of the largest freshwater lakes in India, is located in the Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir.
 
• The Jhelum River originates from Verinag Spring in the Anantnag district of Jammu and Kashmir.
